### tool/vocabulary/corpus/b08/answers/typesetter-pages.txt ### Spread
state view="spread"
state at=2
state sel="f1"
state guides=[{"id":"g1","axis":"v","pos":36},{"id":"g2","axis":"h","pos":54}]
state pages=[{"id":"p1","n":1,"name":"Cover"},{"id":"p2","n":2,"name":"Contents"},{"id":"p3","n":3,"name":"Feature opener"},{"id":"p4","n":4,"name":"Feature"},{"id":"p5","n":5,"name":"Portfolio"},{"id":"p6","n":6,"name":"Back page"}]
state frames=[{"id":"f1","page":2,"title":"Intro column","style":"Body","words":412,"capacity":380,"next":"f2"},{"id":"f2","page":3,"title":"Continued column","style":"Body","words":0,"capacity":360,"next":""}]
state styles=[{"name":"Headline","font":"Canela Bold","size":38,"lead":42,"uses":6},{"name":"Body","font":"Source Serif","size":10,"lead":14,"uses":58},{"name":"Caption","font":"Inter","size":8,"lead":10,"uses":21}]
state fit="fill"
state zoom=100
state frameStyle=""
state frameX=""
state frameY=""
state range=""
state marks=false
state proofGuides=false
App
  Sidebar
    Brand "Folio" icon="menu_book"
    NavItem "Spread" icon="auto_stories" selected={view=="spread"} onTap={view="spread"}
    NavItem "Styles" icon="text_format" selected={view=="styles"} onTap={go styles}
    NavItem "Preflight" icon="fact_check" badge="3" onTap={go preflight}
    Divider
    Text.fieldLabel "Paragraph styles"
    each s in styles
      ListTile "{s.name}" subtitle="{s.font} {s.size}/{s.lead}" trailing="{s.uses}" onTap={emit applyStyle s.name; toast "Applied {s.name}"}
    Spacer grow
    Text.muted "Autumn Issue 14.indd"
  Main
    Nav
      Heading "Spread {at}-{at+1}" level=3
      Row gap=8
        SegmentedButton @view items=["spread","single"]
        IconButton "zoom_out" tooltip="Zoom out" onTap={zoom=max(25,zoom-25)}
        Text.strong "{zoom}%"
        IconButton "zoom_in" tooltip="Zoom in" onTap={zoom=min(400,zoom+25)}
        Button.outline "Export proof" icon="picture_as_pdf" onTap={open proof}
    Column pad=24 gap=16
      Row gap=24 center
        Spread zoom={zoom} guides={guides} onGuide={guides=append(guides,result)}
          Page#left "{at}" side=left master="A-Master" rulers
            Guide axis=v pos=36 draggable
            TextFrame#f1 "Intro column" x=36 y=54 w=240 h=300 style="Body" overflow={frames[0].words>frames[0].capacity} selected={sel=="f1"} onTap={sel="f1"} next="f2"
              Text "The harbour at dawn is quieter than anyone expects. Fishing boats idle against their moorings while the first ferries gather their crews on the quay."
            FrameLink from="f1" to="f2" onTap={sel="f2"}
            ImageFrame#img1 src="https://images.example.com/harbour-dawn.jpg" x=36 y=370 w=240 h=140 fit={fit} selected={sel=="img1"} onTap={sel="img1"}
            PageNumber master="A-Master" position="bottom-left"
          Page#right "{at+1}" side=right master="A-Master"
            TextFrame#f2 "Continued column" x=48 y=54 w=240 h=300 style="Body" selected={sel=="f2"} onTap={sel="f2"}
            PageNumber master="A-Master" position="bottom-right"
        Pane w=320 pad=16 gap=12
          Text.panelTitle "Frame properties"
          if sel=="img1"
            Text.fieldLabel "Image fit"
            Row gap=8
              Button.outline "Fill" onTap={fit="fill"}
              Button.outline "Fit" onTap={fit="fit"}
              Button.outline "Center" onTap={fit="center"}
              Button.outline "Stretch" onTap={fit="stretch"}
            Text.muted "Fit mode: {fit}"
          if sel!="img1"
            Select "Paragraph style" items=["Headline","Body","Caption"] @frameStyle onChange={emit setStyle {"frame":sel,"style":result}}
            Row gap=8
              Input "X" type=number @frameX
              Input "Y" type=number @frameY
            if frames[0].words>frames[0].capacity
              Box fill=#FFFDECEC radius=8 pad=12 gap=8
                Row gap=8
                  Icon "error" color=#FFD32F2F
                  Text.strong "Text overflows" color=#FFD32F2F
                Text.small "{frames[0].words-frames[0].capacity} words do not fit in Intro column."
                Button.outline "Flow into next frame" onTap={emit flow "f1"; toast "Flowed to Continued column"}
          Divider
          Text.panelTitle "Guides"
          each g in guides
            Row between
              Text "{g.axis=="v" ? "Vertical" : "Horizontal"} at {g.pos} pt"
              IconButton "close" tooltip="Remove guide" onTap={guides=removeWhere(guides,x=>x.id==g.id)}
          Row gap=8
            Button.outline "Add vertical" onTap={guides=append(guides,{"id":"g{length(guides)+1}","axis":"v","pos":144})}
            Button.outline "Add horizontal" onTap={guides=append(guides,{"id":"g{length(guides)+1}","axis":"h","pos":200})}
    Footer
      Column gap=8 pad=12
        Row between
          Text.fieldLabel "Pages"
          Text.muted "Drag a page to reorder"
        Row scroll gap=8 drop=page onDrop={pages=reorder(pages,result.data,result.index)}
          each p in pages
            Card gap=4 drag=page(p.id) selected={at==p.n} onTap={at=p.n}
              PageThumb page={p.id} w=56 h=72
              Text.small "{p.n} {p.name}"
              Badge.neutral "A-Master"
  Menu#frameMenu
    MenuItem "Link to next frame" icon="link" onTap={emit linkFrame sel}
    MenuItem "Unlink" icon="link_off" onTap={emit unlinkFrame sel}
    MenuItem "Delete frame" icon="delete" onTap={emit deleteFrame sel}
  Dialog#proof "Export proof" "A low-resolution PDF for review"
    Select "Pages" items=["All 6","Current spread","Range"] @range
    Toggle "Include crop marks" @marks
    Toggle "Show guides" @proofGuides
    Row end gap=8
      Button.ghost "Cancel" onTap={close}
      Button "Export" onTap={emit exportProof {"range":range,"marks":marks}; toast "Proof exported"; close}
### docs/reference/notation/lists.md block 4
state orders=[{"name":"Ada","total":3}]
Page
  Section
    Table o in orders columns=["Name",{"key":"total","label":"Total","align":"end"}]
### docs/reference/notation/lists.md block 10
state orders=[{"id":"o1","name":"Ada Byron","status":"Paid","total":30},{"id":"o2","name":"Lin Chen","status":"Due","total":12}]
state search=""
state status="All"
state sortKey="name"
state chosen=[]
state shown:list={filter(orders, r => (status == 'All' || r.status == status) && contains(lower(r.name), lower(search)))}
Page
  Section
    Row gap=8
      Input "" "Search" @search w=280
      Select @status items=["All","Paid","Due"] w=140
    Table#orders o in shown columns=[{"key":"name","label":"Customer"},{"key":"status","label":"Status","w":120},{"key":"total","label":"Total","w":100,"align":"end"}] sort=@sortKey select=@chosen empty="No orders match."
      Row gap=10
        Avatar "AB" size=28
        Text.strong "{o.name}"
      Badge "{o.status}"
